name: Hearts Faster Than Light - Christmas Special
source:
Have Yourself a Furry Little Christmas!

A standalone holiday entry to the hit visual novel series, Hearts Faster Than Light! Experience your favorite two mismatched crews in their most unfamiliar setting yet... modern day!!! It's all the weird queer furries with all their secrets and drama, but like, nobody is gonna be thrown out into the vacuum of space!
translation:
祝你过一个毛茸茸的小小圣诞节！

这是人气视觉小说系列《Hearts Faster Than Light》的独立节日特别篇！来看看你最喜爱的这两支性格迥异的船员队伍，置身于他们迄今为止最陌生的舞台——现代社会！！！这里依然有那群古怪的酷儿兽人，依然充满了他们各自的秘密与抓马闹剧，只不过这一次，没人会被扔进真空的宇宙里了！
